mergedCopies.meaning: Loss in the sum of encoded per-slab alpha under the one-third normal-incidence merged-copy opacity, compared with unmerged alpha. This is not the percentage of galaxy luminosity lost.

interpretation: No tested global scalar RGBA encoding meets the multi-view gates. The slab encoding approximates spectral transmission and post-integration display. A bright emitter confined to one slab has a normal-incidence channel ceiling of one third over black, regardless of RGB gain. This counterexample proves an exact generic compression claim is invalid; it does not prove every possible approximate LMC fit is impossible.
compositorQualification: Offline decoded-PNG diagnostic only. The software sampler has not been qualified against a real-browser capture; no browser-equivalence claim is made. The discrepancies are far beyond the acceptance gates.
nextDecision: Permit a new optical encoding that lifts the one-third ceiling for dense slabs while keeping at most 33 retained layers. A possible bounded pilot uses 10/9/7 intervals (26 slabs), with two optical layers for seven dense slabs and merged copies for the remaining faint slabs (33 total layers). This is a proposal, not a validated result.
